newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina to auction Letes T-bills Feb 11.
newsitem.headline: Argentina to auction Letes T-bills Feb 11.

text.p: Argentine will auction $250 million of 182-day Letes treasury bills and 250 million pesos of 91-day Letes on Feb 11, the economy ministry said Thursday.
The sale will take place through a Dutch auction. Settlement will be on Feb 14.
Offers are due by 1400 local/1700 GMT.
This is the second bill auction of the year. At last month's auction on Jan 14, 182-day peso Letes fetched a discount strike rate of 6.90 percent and 91-day peso Letes 6.40 percent.
